blind.B1: Yes. Human skeletal muscle biopsies before and 4 h after 60 min cycling at 65% VO2max, so all post-exercise samples carry the exercise factor (abstract). Trial factor: reduced activity (IN) vs normal activity (A). Packet A shows no exercise words in metadata columns, so the factor sits in sample titles/trial labels, not packet A columns.
blind.B2: Abstract only: A post vs pre (793 DEG), IN post vs pre (1,403 DEG), IN vs A at rest (9 DEG), exercise x trial interaction (GSEA). n = 9 subjects (7 M, 2 F); per-group n not given in the abstract.
blind.B3: Yes. Crossover design: each subject is biopsied pre and post in both trials, so subject is the repeated unit. Packet A lists no candidate pairing key (none detected); a subject ID must come from sample titles or characteristics.
blind.B4: The abstract does not say. It reports an interaction of exercise and trial, which implies a joint model, but this is not stated.
blind.B5: The abstract states no DEG rule. Counts only: 9 (rest), 793 (A), 1,403 (IN).
